title: HERMES Agent Guidelines & Architecture Instructions
text: Welcome HERMES repository. HERMES R package ecosystem Real-World Evidence (RWE) Health Economics Outcomes Research (HEOR) focused Healthcare Resource Utilization (HCRU) Cost-Effectiveness Analysis (CEA) OMOP CDM data.

title: HERMES Agent Guidelines & Architecture Instructions
text: Agents developing functions modules HERMES must align implementations 6-stage framework: Define target treatment, comparator, clinical outcome cohorts using standardized vocabularies. Enforce omopgenerics standards cohort table creation cohort naming (snake_case, <100 characters). Build unadjusted baseline tables enriched demographics. Evaluate entry timing cohort attrition. Extract raw unadjusted care utilization (hospitalizations, outpatient visits, ED visits, drug prescriptions) direct medical costs. Fit high-dimensional regularized logistic regression models based baseline clinical features. Provide modular helpers matching, trimming, weighting, SMD balance diagnostic plots. Aggregate longitudinal patient timelines discrete, mutually exclusive health states uniform time cycles. Compute state--state transition probability matrices pull state-specific cost distributions directly OMOP COST table. Provide wrappers exporters decision-analytic state-transition models microsimulations incorporating parametric uncertainty. Export standardized summaries plots Incremental Cost-Effectiveness Ratios (ICER), Net Monetary Benefit (NMB), Cost-Effectiveness Acceptability Curves (CEAC).

title: HERMES Agent Guidelines & Architecture Instructions
text: Language: R (Target R >= 4.1). Pipes: Always use base R pipe |> instead %>%. Assignment: Always use <- assignment (never =). Functions & Arguments: Use lowerCamelCase (e.g. addInpatientHcru(), computeHospitalizationCohorts(), indexDate = "cohort_start_date"). Provide snake_case aliases backward compatibility needed. Database & Cohort Columns: Use snake_case table column names (e.g. cohort_start_date, inpatient_admissions, days_supply, total_paid). S3 Classes: Use snake_case prefixed hermes_ (e.g. hermes_study, hermes_hcru). Never modify core OMOP tables. Write temporary work tables designated result/scratch schemas. Rely omopgenerics accessors (cohortCount(), settings()). create custom extractors official OHDSI/DARWIN package methods exist. Place unit tests tests/testthat/. Ensure new logic test coverage using testthat. Adhere .github/CONTRIBUTING.md extras/PackageMaintenance.R. Run styler::style_dir() lintr::lint_package(".", linters = lintr::linters_with_defaults(lintr::object_name_linter(styles = "camelCase"))) committing.

title: Cohort Utilization & Cost Enrichment

Suited epidemiological studies, patient profiling, multivariable regression. Links clinical event expenditures study subjects tags cost patient’s health state (e.g. State_Baseline vs State_Outcome). title: HCRU Extraction Logic
HCRU Extraction Logic
text: OMOP CDM v5.3+ stores costs polymorphic COST table cost_event_id references primary key domain table indicated cost_domain_id:
code: SELECT    c.person_id,   c.cost_domain_id,   c.cost_type_concept_id,   c.total_paid,   c.total_charge,   c.paid_by_payer,   c.paid_by_patient,   v.visit_concept_id,   v.visit_start_date,   v.visit_end_date FROM cdm.cost c JOIN cdm.visit_occurrence v    ON c.cost_event_id = v.visit_occurrence_id   AND c.cost_domain_id = 'Visit' WHERE c.person_id IN (SELECT subject_id FROM study_cohort);

title: HCRU Extraction Logic
text: Missing Cost Table: database schema lacks COST table, clear warning emitted (Missing 'cost' table CDM), cost columns safely populated 0.0 prevent pipeline crashes. Empty Cost Table: table exists 0 rows, subjects retained 0.0 expenditures. Missing Subject Records: Zero-utilization subjects cohort preserved via left joins coalesce 0.0, ensuring patient attrition cost enrichment.

title: The HERMES Ecosystem: Modular Architecture & Package Suite
text: HERMES (Health Economic Resource Modeling & Evaluation System) R package ecosystem developed IOMED Real-World Evidence (RWE) Health Economics Outcomes Research (HEOR) observational healthcare data structured OMOP Common Data Model (CDM). Starting version 0.5.0, HERMES adopts modular monorepo architecture composed three standalone domain packages DARWIN EU standard, unified root hermes umbrella metapackage.

title: The HERMES Ecosystem: Modular Architecture & Package Suite
text: real-world HEOR workflows, analytical tasks often fall two distinct paradigms: Healthcare Resource Utilization & Direct Costing: Epidemiologists data scientists need enrich OMOP cohorts inpatient admissions, emergency care, outpatient visits, prescriptions, procedures, claims costs -database using lightweight dependencies. Health Economics Modeling & Decision Simulation: Health economists need causal propensity score matching, longitudinal health-state transitions, Markov microsimulations, Bayesian Cost-Effectiveness Analysis (CEA) using specialized statistical packages (Cyclops, BCEA, CohortMethod). Decoupling domains allows users install dependencies required specific workflow maintaining single, unified interface hermes metapackage.

title: The HERMES Ecosystem: Modular Architecture & Package Suite
text: CohortUtilisation standalone, lightweight package designed extract quantify Healthcare Resource Utilization (HCRU) OMOP CDM databases without requiring economic modeling dependencies. implements 3-layer architecture aligned DARWIN EU standards (CohortConstructor, PatientProfiles, CohortCharacteristics): computeHospitalizationCohorts(): Collapses contiguous/overlapping inpatient stays derives 30-day readmissions. computeInfusionCohorts(): Identifies parenteral intravenous therapy episodes. addInpatients() / addHospitalizations(): Inpatient admissions, length stay (LOS), ICU utilization, 30d/90d readmissions, specialty breakdown. addEmergencyCare() / addEmergency(): Emergency encounters captured via visit concepts Emergency Medicine provider specialties. addOutpatientVisits(): Primary care (GP), specialist, outpatient visits. addVisits(): Composite multi-setting enricher covering Inpatient, Outpatient, Emergency care one call. addPrescriptions(): Medication fills, cumulative days supply, Proportion Days Covered (PDC). addProcedures(): Diagnostic measurements, laboratory tests, clinical procedures. summariseUtilization(): Aggregates metrics standardized summarised_result objects. tableUtilization(): Formats publication-ready tables gt, flextable, tibble. plotUtilization(): Renders ggplot2 visualizations utilization distributions.

title: The HERMES Ecosystem: Modular Architecture & Package Suite
text: CohortEconomics core Health Economics Outcomes Research (HEOR) modeling package. implements complete 6-stage analytical pipeline cohort definition decision analysis: Stage 1: Cohort Generation & Initialization (init()): Sets target treatment, comparator, clinical outcome cohorts. Stage 2: Descriptive Baseline & HCRU Extraction (summarise_baseline(), extract_hcru()): Computes demographics, baseline characteristics, care utilization health-state tagging. Stage 3: Causal Propensity Score (PS) Adjustment (fit_ps(), adjust_ps(), assess_balance()): Fits regularized logistic regression via Cyclops perform caliper matching evaluate covariate balance (SMD). Stage 4: Trajectory Compilation & State-Cost Extraction (compile_trajectories()): Converts longitudinal patient timelines Markov health-state transition matrices state-specific cost distributions. Stage 5: Economic Simulation (simulate_economics()): Runs probabilistic sensitivity analysis (PSA) simulating lifetime costs Quality-Adjusted Life-Years (QALYs). Stage 6: Decision Analysis & Post-Processing (run_cea(), plot_ceac(), plot_plane(), table_summary()): Calculates Incremental Cost-Effectiveness Ratios (ICER) Net Monetary Benefit (NMB) via BCEA.

title: Introduction to HEOR for OMOP Users
text: new drug intervention enters market, regulatory bodies (like FDA EMA) care safety efficacy. However, healthcare payers (governments, insurance companies, Health Technology Assessment (HTA) bodies like NICE UK) ask different question: “new treatment worth extra money?” Cost-Effectiveness Analysis (CEA) formal mathematical process used answer question. compares relative costs outcomes (effects) different courses action.

what: The Key Metrics: ICER and QALY
title: Introduction to HEOR for OMOP Users
text: compare apples apples across different diseases, health economists use standardized metrics: QALY (Quality-Adjusted Life-Year): measure disease burden, including quality quantity life lived. One QALY equates one year perfect health. ICER (Incremental Cost-Effectiveness Ratio): core output CEA. represents additional cost per additional unit health gained (usually per QALY). ICER=CostTarget−CostComparatorEffectTarget−EffectComparator ICER = \frac{Cost_{Target} - Cost_{Comparator}}{Effect_{Target} - Effect_{Comparator}} new drug costs $50,000 standard care provides 1 additional QALY, ICER $50,000/QALY. Payers “Willingness--Pay” (WTP) threshold (e.g., $100,000/QALY). ICER threshold, drug considered cost-effective.

title: Health Economics and Outcomes Research Pipeline on OMOP CDM (Metapackage)
text: Stage 1: Cohort Generation (init): Define target treatment, comparator, clinical outcome cohorts. Stage 2: Descriptive Baseline & HCRU Characterization (summarise_baseline, extract_hcru): Build unadjusted baseline tables, enrich demographics (via PatientProfiles), extract care utilization direct medical costs. Stage 3: Causal Propensity Score Adjustment (fit_ps, adjust_ps, assess_balance): Fit regularized logistic regression (via Cyclops) based baseline clinical features estimate propensity scores balance cohorts. Stage 4: Trajectory Compilation & State-Cost Extraction (compile_trajectories): Slice longitudinal patient timelines discrete health states, extracting transition probability matrices state-specific expenditure distributions. Stage 5: Economic Simulation (simulate_economics): Run Markov state-transition microsimulation Probabilistic Sensitivity Analysis (PSA) project lifetime costs QALYs. Stage 6: Decision Analysis & Post-Processing (run_cea): Compute Incremental Cost-Effectiveness Ratios (ICER) Net Monetary Benefit (NMB), generating CEAC cost-effectiveness plane plots powered BCEA.
